eps.ov: Now that the Unova League is over, our heroes contemplate what the future holds, while a new friend helps them deal with a blast from the past!
eps.oa: انتهى «دوري إيشو»، فيتأمل أبطالنا ما يخبئه المستقبل، بينما يعينهم صديق جديد على مواجهة ماضٍ يعود فجأة!

eps.ov: On a ship heading to meet Professor Cedric Juniper at the White Ruins, our heroes are introduced to a young man with an unusual gift and an equally unusual point of view!
eps.oa: على متن سفينة متجهة إلى لقاء البروفيسور «أراراغي» الأب في «الأطلال البيضاء»، يتعرف أبطالنا إلى شاب ذي موهبة غير مألوفة ووجهة نظر غير مألوفة مثلها!

eps.t: There's a New Gym Leader in Town!
eps.ov: After arriving in Aspertia City at the request of Professor Juniper, our heroes pay a visit to one of the most unusual Gyms they've ever seen!
eps.oa: بعد الوصول إلى مدينة «هيغاكي» بطلب من «أراراغي»، يزور أبطالنا واحدة من أغرب الصالات التي رأوها قط!

eps.ov: Continuing their journey to the White Ruins, our heroes encounter a mysterious organization with a sinister plot!
As our heroes continue their journey to the White Ruins, they come across a Mareep ranch with some fog and leadership issues!
Team Plasma is on the move, and so is N!
Arriving in Virbank City, our heroes and N encounter another group of heroes with some surprising results!

eps.t: The Fires of a Red-Hot Reunion!
eps.ov: After discovering a festival celebrating the sights and sounds of the Kanto region, Ash reunites with an old friend, who shows what real staying power is all about!
Team Plasma is determined to execute its evil plans, but our heroes and N have other ideas!

eps.t: Secrets from Out of the Fog!
eps.ov: As our heroes continue their journey to the White Ruins, they learn startling secrets about N and Team Plasma!
As Team Plasma's mission to control Pokémon continues, Team Rocket's mission takes aim at Team Plasma!

eps.t: Ash and N: A Clash of Ideals!
eps.ov: As our heroes unite with Professor Cedric Juniper at the White Ruins, it soon becomes obvious that they're not the only ones on a quest for information about Reshiram!

eps.t: Team Plasma and the Awakening Ceremony!
eps.ov: As Team Plasma's plan to steal the Light Stone unfolds, our heroes and their friends are doing everything they can to stop it!

eps.t: What Lies Beyond Truth and Ideals!
eps.ov: As the evil plan to control Reshiram continues to unfold, the survival of the world lies in Team Plasma's defeat. But can they be defeated?!
